active.title: Survive Day One
active.description: The world ended this morning. 98% of humanity is gone. The System is real. Something enormous is in the sky over your city. Figure out what happened and stay alive long enough for it to matter.

objectives.text: Get a view of the situation
Find the other survivors in your district (2 remaining)
Avoid alien contact until you know what you are dealing with

active.title: The Lit Window
active.description: From the church tower you spotted warm lamp light in a flat on Josephinenstraße, 800m NE. Someone is in there. One of the other survivors in the district — or someone in a very bad situation.

objectives.text: Make contact with whoever is in the flat
